analysis:
Amplitude now carries a measured fill probability. Until today the amplitude lane ranked every candidate on a flat 0.5 guess. It now measures, per item, how often a filled trough-bid was actually followed by the peak-ask printing within four days — fitting the levels strictly before each day it scores, so the number can't be true by construction. The spread is wide and unflattering: 48% on Amulet of fury down to 0 of 37 on Saturated heart, which was advertising +5.88m/cycle and has dropped from A- to D. Treat it as an upper bound — it reads hourly aggregates, not real fills.

The band and churn boards are unchanged by that work. Band is led by the big-ticket gear pair (Confliction gauntlets, Inquisitor's great helm, both ~+1.7% at A-) on flat/ranging books; churn's S+ tier is the usual high-turnover commodities where volume, not margin, does the work. Several churn rows are reach-fold floored to break-even — there's nothing to price above BE on those, so skip them rather than shaving the ask.
